title: Assumptions & limitations
intro: WORKFACE plans and records thermal work-windows. It is advisory and contractual — it does not certify, and it does not replace the field measurement the referenced standards require.
generated_by: T3, Day 9 (Task J). Coefficient sensitivities computed from the current code.

limitations.title: No wind field
limitations.body: FortyGuard env_params carries no wind speed. Wind drives the evaporation rate, WBGT, the convective term in the surface model, and the TMS 602 masonry trigger. We take wind as a site-level scalar from a free feed — not spatially resolved.

limitations.title: The surface model is a model
limitations.body: A first-order energy balance calibrated from published absorptivity/emissivity ranges and validated for plausibility, not against a field probe. It does not replace the surface thermometer the standards require.

limitations.title: 12-hour forecast horizon
limitations.body: Handled by the three-tier architecture. Tier 0 is a climatological probability, not a forecast — the UI must say so.

limitations.title: Registry depth
limitations.body: 12 trades, US practice, hand-curated (registry 2026.08.20-a). Real deployment needs the submittal-register integration for that project's approved product data sheets.

limitations.title: Advisory, not certifying
limitations.body: WORKFACE plans and records; it does not certify and does not replace inspection or the engineer of record.

limitations.title: Sparse imagery on greenfield
limitations.body: streetview and satellite coverage is thin on greenfield sites; coverage gaps degrade with a visible confidence downgrade (the twin steps down one level when the back hemisphere is unsegmented — all 40 demo captures).

limitations.title: The schedule is synthetic
limitations.body: The 328-activity P6 schedule is generated. The geography is real (Phoenix-area site) and the standards are real (SSPC-PA 1, ACI 301/305/305.1, TMS 602, OSHA heat guidance). Float, milestone dates and sequencing are illustrative.

calibration.sensitivity: The knife-edge. Worst dawn offset margin on WF-FAB2-07: -0.02 C at eps=0.85 (closure holds by a hair) -> +3.47 C at eps=0.23 (bright galvanising, closure vanishes). Computed from current code.
Same fragility as eps; the dawn closure scales linearly with it.
Below the offset, coating is out-of-spec (RFI-only).

calibration.source: WORKFACE placeholder bands, pending ACGIH licence (ACGIH table copyrighted)
calibration.sensitivity: wbgt_rest_ratio_escalate fires below 0.5 work fraction (>50% rest).
48 protected hours inside a 72 h horizon — only one window survives per face; the rest is NO_DATA (fail closed).
The fractional float cap catches a thin-float near-critical activity an absolute cap never could.
Night-only compliant windows surface as crew-unavailable and route to a lit night-shift mitigation, never a silent night booking.

closure_condition: The dawn dew-point closure requires a clear, dry, calm dawn. A humid monsoon dawn does not close the window (more cloud shrinks the (1 - cloud/8) net-longwave term). The demo stands on a clear-sky August dawn.
